# How to escape
This guide explains how to breach containment if you are assigned the role of SCP-106.
[textlink="General information about the Old Man" link="Scp106About"]
[textlink="More on containing the Old Man as facility personnel" link="Scp106Containment"]
## Main method
This method uses the [bold]"Become a Phantom"[/bold] ability, which is available from the start.
[textlink="More about abilities" link="Scp106Abilities"]
[bold]While in phantom form, you can:[/bold] - Pass through any obstacle - Move freely around the facility
Note that while in this state, being examined by a person can kill the phantom!
## How can I resist capture?
Once you leave your containment chamber, personnel will begin trying to capture you. Your job is to resist.
Attack them if you can, but remember that you move very slowly. Prioritize checking D-Block, because that is where personnel will take people from to restore your containment conditions!
